== Set 1 edition names ==
Bill approved consistent Luke/Vader Set 1 names: Original (unnumbered), Numbered (black-on-white) / Numbered (white-on-black) for the distinct Dark Side options, one Numbered entry for Luke’s identical Light Side panels, Premium, and Remastered (2006). Article moves retain redirects; the shared navigators and direct links use the descriptive edition names. Publication history replaces the generic Errata heading on these Set 1 articles; historical catalog codes are retained in source. Card identities, printed text, statistics, images and source attribution are unchanged. Legacy Block classifications are outside this batch. == Printed wording comparison ==
The original Virtual Set #1a sheet and this later complete face use different printed wording. The battle sentence replaces the once-per-battle wording and explicitly includes cumulatively.<ref>Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards1a.pdf Virtual Set #1a], complete original sheet; [[:File:Holotable-OVS1-Darth-Vader-v17.gif|later complete card face]].</ref> The comparison establishes different printed wording; it does not establish a same-word predecessor for the Remastered date field. The existing edition name and the Released bound for this later carrier are retained.
